name: agentconfig
description: AgentConfig Bundle — a portable, encrypted format for sharing AI agent configurations across desktop clients.
author: Zhuah Dong

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @agentconfig/core && npm run build --workspace @agentconfig/cli && npm run build --workspace @agentconfig/deepseek-harness
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @agentconfig/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentconfig/cli && npm run typecheck --workspace @agentconfig/deepseek-harness
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run site:check
